title: 進路セミナーⅠ
subtitle: Career Planning Seminar I
educationalGoal: To develop a vision for future careers and careers as an engineer, and to set goals for further education and employment that suit oneself. The purpose of this course is to set goals and make the necessary preparations and measures to achieve those goals.
advice: In the Career Planning Seminar I, students will analyze themselves using a job-hunting notebook, and develop their career outlook by attending special lectures. The followings are carried out. 1. Self-analysis and self-promotion (self-analysis using a job-hunting notebook and creating a self-promotion sheet) 2. Special lectures (the latest job market, advice on continuing your education, the meaning of work and the type of engineer companies are looking for, etc.)  Depending on the progress of the lectures, the schedule and content may be changed or added as appropriate.
books: Textbooks: None Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Career Planning Seminar I is a required course aimed at helping students going on to graduate school or finding jobs. Therefore, all students are resquired to attend regardless of own study continuation plans.

activityGoals.body: Be able to consider the relationship between career planning and life design
Be able to identify advantages and disadvantages in career development
Be able to assess your own knowledge, ability, skill, and qualification, as needed to determine a career plan
Be able to present your own career planning policies and goals

achievementLevels.ideal: Be able to do the following things based on your own understanding from the various career planning activities: (1) Sufficiently consider the relationship between career planning and life design (2) Fully analyze your advantages and disadvantages for development of your career (3) Investigate the knowledge, ability, skill, and qualification needed to determine your career plan (4) Present your own career planning policies and goals in detail
achievementLevels.standard: Be able to do the following things based on your own understanding from the various career planning activities: (1) Consider the relationship between career planning and life design (2) Analyze your advantages and disadvantages for development of your career (3) Investigate the knowledge, ability, skill, and qualification needed to determine your career plan (4) Present your own career planning policies and goals

lessons.content: Based on the learning support plan, students will understand the learning objectives, overview and behavioral goals of the subject. In particular, students will understand which part of the educational goals of the Department of Mechanical Engineering this subject contributes to and the specific target level of achievement. Students will consider the importance of self-analysis and self- realization, career choice and corporate research.
lessons.assignments: (Preparation) Understand the relationship between the educational goals of the Department of Mechanical Engineering and this subject. Check the contents of the Employment Notes. (Review) Use the job hunting notebook to review the content necessary for self-analysis.
